title: Handling multiple tracking area codes from the lower layers

entities.name: TAI selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to select a TAI when multiple TACs are received from lower layers in satellite NG-RAN cells. The UE constructs TAIs by concatenating current PLMN identity with each TAC and applies selection criteria based on registration area, allowed/non-allowed areas, and forbidden areas.

entities.name: Tracking Area Identity
entities.description: Constructed by concatenating current PLMN identity with each TAC received from lower layers. Represents a tracking area that the UE can potentially select.

entities.name: Tracking Area Code
entities.description: Multiple TACs received from lower layers when UE camps on satellite NG-RAN cell. Used to construct TAIs for selection.

entities.name: TAI in current registration area
entities.description: Condition where at least one TAI belongs to the UE's current registration area. Triggers selection criteria based on allowed/non-allowed tracking areas.

entities.name: TAI in allowed area and not in non-allowed area
entities.description: Condition where TAI belongs to allowed tracking area list (if any) and does not belong to non-allowed tracking areas list (if any).

entities.name: TAI not in forbidden areas
entities.description: Condition where TAI belongs to neither 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming nor 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service.

entities.name: Implementation-specific TAI selection
entities.description: When multiple TAIs meet criteria equally, UE selects TAI in implementation-specific way, potentially considering LADN service area information.

entities.name: Current TAI assignment
entities.description: The selected TAI becomes the current TAI for the UE.

entities.name: TAI selection trigger conditions
entities.description: Conditions that trigger TAI selection: UE receives multiple TACs from lower layers, or UE has received multiple TACs and registration area/allowed/non-allowed/forbidden lists are updated.

relations.description: TAI selection procedure involves constructing TAIs from multiple TACs and current PLMN.
TAI is constructed by concatenating current PLMN identity with each TAC.
TAI selection procedure is guarded by whether TAIs are in current registration area.
When TAI is in registration area, selection is further guarded by allowed/non-allowed area conditions.
When multiple TAIs meet allowed/non-allowed criteria equally, implementation-specific selection is established.
When no TAI is in registration area, selection is guarded by forbidden area conditions.
When all TAIs are forbidden, implementation-specific selection is established.
TAI selection procedure establishes the selected TAI as current TAI.
Trigger conditions start the TAI selection procedure.
